card.name: Friend-Summoning Son Gohan
card.skill: [Auto] When you play this card, look at up to 7 cards from the top of your deck. Choose up to 1 <Krillin> among them and add it to your hand.

qa.q: You use {BT1-061 Friend-Summoning Son Gohan}’s auto skill to look at cards from the top of your deck, and place cards that are not “Krillin” back on top. Do you shuffle your deck afterwards?
qa.a:
Yes, you do.
The skill of {BT1-061 Friend-Summoning Son Gohan} has been updated, and is different from the text currently printed on the card.
The updated skill is as follows:
“[Auto] When you play this card, look at up to 7 cards from the top of your deck. Choose up to 1 ＜Krillin＞ among them and add it to your hand. Then shuffle your deck.”

qa.q: Can you choose to play the card with the skill as printed?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
Please apply the updated skill when using the card.

qa.q: You activated a skill that allows you to search through your deck. As part of resolving that skill, can you take a thorough look at the cards in your deck and confirm what cards are in your deck and Life Area?
qa.a:
No, you cannot.
Resolve the skill as quickly as possible, and do not look at other cards unless absolutely necessary.

qa.q: When looking at a specified number of cards from the top of your deck, do you need to declare the number of cards beforehand?
qa.a:
No, that’s not necessary.
You can stop looking at cards from the top of your deck whenever you like as long as you do not exceed the limit specified in the skill.

qa.q: Can you add {BT1-072 Human Shield Krillin} to your hand with {Friend-Summoning Son Gohan}’s skill?
qa.a:
Yes, you can.
The character name of {BT1-072 Human Shield Krillin} is “Krillin” so the condition specified on the card text is fulfilled.
